systems.tiers: Signed 22 April 2026; creates the OTDI within the Office of the President; requires a prioritised roadmap from the OTDI within 180 days and draft legislation within 12 months

systems.owner: Office of Technology, Digitalization and Innovation (OTDI), Office of the President
systems.tiers: Whole-of-government modernisation of public service delivery across ministries, agencies and commissions

note: The order covers digitalising the state's own administration and services; it is a directive with a roadmap still to be prepared, not a national digital strategy.
